name: home.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home.scss — view-home scoped styles: section wrappers + headings for the
//  home page route (adopted into the view's shadow root).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/placeholders';

// ── Sections ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.home-section {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    padding-bottom: var(--space-6xl);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-xl;

    font-weight: 100;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: left;
    padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding-top: to-rem(120);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      padding-top: to-rem(140);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      padding-top: to-rem(160);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-top: to-rem(180);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }

    &--archive {
      @extend .ttl-md;

      font-weight: 100;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--grey-2);
      padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
      margin-top: to-rem($space-sm);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
      @include layout-1440() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }
  }

  // Selected section: edge-to-edge carousel, title stays grid-aligned
  &--selected {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;

    // Title aligns with the left edge of the carousel slides.
    // Selected slides: 88vw mobile → 82vw@768 → 78vw@1024 → 72vw@1440 → 66vw@2560
    // Padding = (100vw - slide_width) / 2
    .home-section-title {
      padding-top: 0;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
      padding-left: calc((100vw - 88vw) / 2);
      padding-right: calc((100vw - 88vw) / 2);
      box-sizing: border-box;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 82vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 82vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 78vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 78vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-1440() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 72vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 72vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-2560() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 66vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 66vw) / 2);
      }
    }
  }

  // Archive section: edge-to-edge carousel, title stays grid-aligned
  &--archive {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    // Title aligns with the left edge of the selected carousel slides (same padding)
    .home-section-title {
      padding-left: calc((100vw - 88vw) / 2);
      padding-right: calc((100vw - 88vw) / 2);
      box-sizing: border-box;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 82vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 82vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 78vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 78vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-1440() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 72vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 72vw) / 2);
      }
      @include layout-2560() {
        padding-left: calc((100vw - 66vw) / 2);
        padding-right: calc((100vw - 66vw) / 2);
      }
    }

    // Explore carousel: 100% on mobile, 61% centered on desktop
    .aw-c--explore {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto to-rem($space-5xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        width: 80%;
      }
      @include layout-1024() {
        width: 70%;
      }
      @include layout-1440() {
        width: 61%;
      }
      @include layout-2560() {
        width: 55%;
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Shared link reset inside carousel slides ─────────────────────────────────
.home-item-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

// ── Skeleton state for selected cover ────────────────────────────────────────
.home-skel-selected {
  width: 100%;
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
